scenario: [LCDB.3.2.1] with [LTIM.2.8.2]: a cooldown compares elapsed time, so one whose window would end past the top of the clock's range still suppresses. The clock is set to 2^63 - 1 - 2 s and rule `r cooldown 1_h` fires for key 1. The clock advances 1 s, and the same key's fact is asserted again with a new `n`, a new activation of the same key. It is suppressed: 1 s has passed of 1 h. Exactly ["fire 1"]. A runtime that adds the last firing and the window overflows `int64`, reads the deadline as passed, and logs twice. PATH PINNED: libds's `adapter_ds_rate_allow` (`rete/adapters.c`), the elapsed-time comparison; the Mercury runtime's `ds.rate.decide`.
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    k: Int key
    n: Int mutable

rule r cooldown 1_h:
    Trig t
->
    log info "fire {t.k}"
